quest.title: Surreptitious Seven-Star Seal Sundering
quest.description: You have accepted a commission that requires you to pay The Chasm a visit. Who knows what the situation in the long-sealed mines might be like...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x50, Mora x40000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me more about The Chasm?

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Right, so about the Chasm... If you don't intend to leave just yet, you're free to explore the area a bit. But please do keep your actions within the remit of Liyue's laws and statutes.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: I should mention, though, that there is a place that I highly recommend you avoid.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: For example, the great mine in the center of The Chasm has had a Seven-Star Array cast over it... By which I mean exactly what I say — it is a seal placed over the area by the Qixing.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, that's quite the clear explanation.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: As for the weak... I mean, focal point of the array, it lies in the Bedrock Keys surrounding the area. These were placed by the Qixing themselves. Connected in series, they affix the energy flowing through the array.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: The area around the Bedrock Keys has seen an abnormal amount of Geo elemental coalescences. It's almost as if the "thing" beneath yearns to finally emerge...

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: ...Uh, never mind me, I was just talking to myself. So yes, that's how things are. Please do not — and I repeat, do not — go near the Seven-Star Array, and don't even think about going down there to explore.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: The Bedrock Keys are definitely not losing structural integrity, and the surrounding areas are most certainly not plagued by any strange Geo elemental convergences. So please, don't you think of doing anything at all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But...

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Hmph, I know what you're going to ask.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: There are most certainly no precious treasures down there, nor are there any prehistoric fossils to be had. And banish any thoughts you have about giant ancient ruins... Yes, please do not bear any fruitless expectations toward this place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The way you're saying all this is super suspicious!

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Not even mushrooms will grow down there! Nor are there wish-granting stones! And there are definitely no sailors who grow strong just by eating mushrooms! Again, do not get your hopes up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, yeah, sure! There's no need to be so fierce...

choices.text: Anything else I should look out for?

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: I suggest that you go speak to Zhiqiong first. She is an adventurer hired by the Ministry and was once a miner here. She knows The Chasm's geography like the back of her hand...

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Also, let me write you a certification real quick. When she sees it, she'll know that you're trustworthy.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: That said, I must warn you that Zhiqiong is definitely not the sort of person who has trouble standing still, and definitely has no thoughts of undoing the array and having a look underground.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: So there's no way that she would ever put a team of idle adventurers together to brazenly enter hazardous areas! As such, you can forget about asking her to help you enter The Chasm's mines.

choices.text: Uh huh. Got it.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Did... did you really?

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: As long as you understand, we're good, in which case, I won't take up any more of your time.

choices.text: Uh... yeah, I got it.
Got it, then. Come, Paimon, let's go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, let's go!

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Wait! I haven't finished!

talks.objective: Talk to Muning and find out the situation in The Chasm

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, so there are stories about us too...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Of course! They are very popular in the city, you know? If you ask me, I'd say that Tea Master Liu Su and Iron Tongue Tian are both good in their own way, but I just prefer Iron...

choices.text: *cough*

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Oh, don't worry, I get it, I get it. Iron Tongue Tian's style is definitely not for everyone. I do sometimes find that his choice of words and phrases features too much slang...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: But as for Liu Su... He takes a while to get going, you know? Sometimes, you're there for two hours before you start going "oh hey, this is pretty good!" Some people like that style, but I find it uninteresting...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: And if you mean to say that "this is just a story, it won't get stale," let me just say this — if this were food or drink we were talking about, it would surely go bad if we wrapped it up and covered it for half a day without opening it up...

choices.text: *cough*

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Oh, are you alright? Something wrong with your throat?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, no... It's probably just a case of too much information.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Uh... Um, sorry. I got a bit too excited there and didn't really consider if you were interested in what I was saying. Hehe...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: #Still, since you're here, {NICKNAME}, are you here at the Qixing's behest? Did Muning end up revealing some other information to you? Um, you know, like...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: "Don't touch the Bedrock Keys! There's nothing under The Chasm! Zhiqiong won't help you!" You know, stuff like that, repeated over and over?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Muning did indeed tell us all that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hah! Well, he didn't scare us!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Hehe, indeed, he wasn't doing that at all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh?

choices.text: So all the things he mentioned are true?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: *cough* Well, Muning is, in the end, a specialist hired by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. Even if he wanted to ask for help, there's a lot that he's not allowed to reveal in public.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: So he can only "warn" us, and thus impart the means of getting into The Chasm to you in a roundabout way. In essence, when he says "you shouldn't," he really means that "you can."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What a weird guy...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: In any case, you also mentioned that he wrote you a certification and told you to come find me.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: That note which you now carry means that you have the authorization to travel through The Chasm without any obstruction. Of course, barring any personal intervention by the Qixing.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: And the fact that he suggested that you find me means that I should tell you the way into the depths of The Chasm!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh!?

choices.text: That Muning...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Hahaha! Well, for what it's worth, I apologize for all the covering-up that we're doing. But trust me, we have very good reasons for doing so.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: While the "thing" that they dug up under The Chasm is truly abnormal, our investigations cannot be done with too much pomp and ceremony, lest the people be alarmed... That is the Qixing's standing order.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: As such, we can only function under the cover of a no-entry order, secretly gathering explorers and scholars to enter The Chasm and conduct investigations.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: This is all to, if necessary and where possible, stave off the crisis that festers beneath the earth.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So all the people at the encampment were...?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: That's right. They were all brought on as support staff. They're all pretty reliable... uh, well, mostly.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: That you came here is also no coincidence. More than one big shot in the Qixing has already recommended that we enlist your aid. And honestly? We've little reason not to comply.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: In any case, it is also said that your aid is not necessarily difficult to enlist...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Doesn't that mean that we were tricked?

choices.text: Well, Paimon, time to leave.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, that's right! Don't you treat us like a bunch of idiots!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Uh, please wait! I was just passing on my superior's message. Those were her words, not mine! Just, uh, let me take those words back, alright?

choices.text: Byeee!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Come now, this is the Qixing we're talking about! They won't short-change you for your aid!

choices.text: It's not as if I'm short on Mora or anything...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon too...! Well, that said, having more Mora isn't a bad thing...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: *cough* Well, if we could mitigate the safety hazards in The Chasm, any underground treasures or valuables will be given to the one who discovers them.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: This is a special privilege given by the Qixing, just to the two of you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? No tricks now!

choices.text: Well, in that case...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! Treasure!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Haha, alright, alright. Can we safely say that you've accepted this commission, then?

choices.text: Alright, we'll do it for the treasure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woohoo! New treasure!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Alright! Here's to a new adventure, then!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Again, let me apologize for wasting your time on all these other things. Let's get down to business, shall we?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: If we wish to enter The Chasm, we first need to find an Adjuvant made from a material known as Lumenstone. Only with it can we move in the dark down there.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Only those with Visions can use this Adjuvant, but considering that you can use elemental energies without a Vision, it's my guess that you should have no problem making use of the Adjuvant.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, where do we find this thing?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: It's in a warehouse to the south. The warehouse is well-guarded, so it should be pretty secure. Just come back once you've gotten ahold of the catalyst.

choices.text: Alright, I'll do it for you, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehehe, that's right!

choices.text: And Paimon's Treasure Time begins once again...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, you see... The Chasm is such a big place... Just imagine how much treasure there's going to be for our taking...

choices.text: I don't exactly need help putting up missing person posters this time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then why don't you just ask for something else this time?

choices.text: Hmph.
Oh, is that how it is? See ya then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Aren't we at least going to ask them what they're offering?

choices.text: What a convoluted way of hinting...
So, what did he intend to say?
I think I said that I wasn't all that interested in storytelling.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... We don't really know what you mean by all this.

choices.text: Um, I'm not too familiar with the storytelling tradition...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back, you big liar!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Eh? Me? What happened?

choices.text: No one was guarding the warehouse at all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What do you mean, "it's well-guarded"?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Huh? That... shouldn't be the case. When I was guarding the place, the Treasure Hoarders wouldn't even dare come near it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Wait a moment. Who did you say was guarding the warehouse, again?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Uh, me?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, are you guarding it right now?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Well, come on now. Which adventurer in their right mind would let themselves get tied down with such a boring task, am I right?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Ah. Right.

choices.text: Well, putting your dereliction of duty to one side for the time being...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: R—Right.

choices.text: Let's talk about how we'll undo the array instead, shall we...
There were even Treasure Hoarders over there!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And even they were wondering why no one was guarding the place!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Huh, you destroy— I mean, undid the bindings on the Bedrock Key so easily! Guess we were right to put our faith in you two!

choices.text: I'm quite sure we just damaged public property...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Eh, Muning has already sent a damage report ahead of us. So technically, the Bedrock Keys were damaged *before* we arrived, not after.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Well, that leaves four more that we need to handle. Ah, yes, I've drawn a basic diagram that shows where three of the four are. I hope it'll be of use to you.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: As for the last one... Honestly, I'm not very sure where that is anymore. After the miners were dismissed, there was a seepage incident in that mine, causing the cylinder to be submerged under the waters...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: In any case, just settle the other three sites. We'll meet up after that and think about what to do next...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Not coming along with us?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Not this time... I mean, I was originally assigned to guard the warehouse, but thanks to my slip-up, I nearly let the Treasure Hoarders in there. Honestly, I'm already in your debt for not reporting my error...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Things could get bad if Muning catches me and puts me on the trail of some errands again, so I'll just stand guard as I should... For now.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Still, I believe that this riddle will be no match for the two of you at all!

choices.text: Won't the Qixing investigate this matter...?

talks.objective: Tell Zhiqiong about what happened at the warehouse
Look for a way to destroy the Bedrock Keys

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you! Hello there!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Muning was the one who introduced me. This is his...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Yes, yes, forget that sheet of paper. I already know who you are just fine!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: That Muning... All he does is put on airs and write papers. Everything's gotta follow this or that procedure and all that tripe. You know, stuff that makes you look important. I couldn't care less for that stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: In any case, your name is already well-known throughout the Adventurers' Guild, never mind any of your other contributions to Liyue.

choices.text: I'm that famous?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Of course, many new recruits at the Guild have heard of your exploits on Dragonspine from Iris. Hehe, that includes me, you know?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Piercing the frigid blizzard to open a path, discovering an ancient, forgotten kingdom beneath the ice and frost, reaching the perilous summit, confronting the great change that came over that place with a mortal form...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: The things you've experienced, the obstacles you've overcome, the truths you've uncovered... They can be summed up in one word: adventure! True adventure!

choices.text: Precisely!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow. This is actually quite a shock to Paimon. Are we really that awesome?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Haha! And this isn't even mentioning the great battle you had with that sea monster on the Jade Chamber. Now, I wasn't there to witness it, mind you, but I haven't missed a single telling of that story!

choices.text: Ah, someone give me a compass...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, you really don't take praise well, do you?

choices.text: Well, this is me we're talking about.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That's right! We're the legendary duo — {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

talks.objective: Use the cage-shaped object to destroy the three remaining Bedrock Keys

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you! Hello there!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Muning was the one who introduced me. This is his...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Yes, yes, forget that sheet of paper. I already know who you are just fine!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: That Muning... All he does is put on airs and write papers. Everything's gotta follow this or that procedure and all that tripe. You know, stuff that makes you look important. I couldn't care less for that stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: In any case, your name is already well-known throughout the Adventurers' Guild, never mind any of your other contributions to Liyue.

choices.text: I'm that famous?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Haha! I mean, you had that great battle with that sea monster on the Jade Chamber. Now, I wasn't there to witness the event, mind you, but I haven't missed a single telling of that story!

choices.text: Well, this is me we're talking about.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That's right! We're the legendary duo — {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I won't run off. Just retrieve the Lumenstone Adjuvant, and things should go fine.

talks.objective: Use the cage-shaped object to destroy the three remaining Bedrock Keys

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Honestly, I'm not too sure about how the Bedrock Key works, but you could start from looking into those cage-shaped Geo elemental formations over there.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is that?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: These strange formations have been puzzling the Ministry of Civil Affairs for some time now. They seem to have grown up from the bedrock of The Chasm over the last two years, and their properties are very similar to those of the "thing" underground.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: We say this because they can undergo some kind of disintegration when under the influence of the anomalies.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Later, Huishan Hall's investigations revealed that they have been absorbing Geo elemental energy from the surroundings, slowly eroding the structure of the Bedrock Keys...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: It is a most ominous phenomenon, almost like something is consciously trying to break the sealing array.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: We have to clear them out twice every month, but they will always grow back quickly... and they have only grown back quicker over time.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Perhaps that "thing" below is growing restless... and that is why the Qixing has sent us to investigate.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Please don't talk to me for the time being, or I'll get in trouble again...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Again"...?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Uh, just don't sweat that...

talks.objective: Use the cage-shaped object to destroy the three remaining Bedrock Keys

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Very impressive! That should be the last one. With this, the array sealing The Chasm has dissipated, and we can explore the area underground.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: That said... We should probably go and pay Muning a visit first. Hmph, not that he's going to do anything other than scold us, though.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: See? What did I say? You weren't guarding the warehouse as you should've at all!

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: You've really done it this time, Zhiqiong. How are we going to resolve this matter, huh? Are you going to take responsibility for undoing the array of your own accord? Can you?

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here. *sigh* So... how are you going to explain destroying the Bedrock Keys?

choices.text: From an aesthetic point of view, this place looks better without them.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: You...! Ugh, alright! You're taking responsibility for this. As for the rest, we'll wait for the Qixing to make their judgment first.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Hehe, don't you worry, Muning only gets mad at people who don't care. Otherwise, he's just a worrywart — not a bad person.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Well, let's leave his stubborn temper aside first. Once you're ready, I'll round everyone up to follow you down into the mines.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Our purpose this time is to reach the deepest level of The Chasm, map it, and... uh, investigate the source of the anomalies.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Ah, yes, I almost forgot — welcome to the Chasm Exploration Team!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: If you'll allow me a bit of your time, let me introduce you to the team.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: This is Khedive, a scholar specifically called in from Sumeru. His specialties are ores and biology. He's this exploration team's leading man... well, in scientific and financial matters, at least.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: This is Jinwu, who's in charge of safety. The repair and maintenance of any facilities we use and our security is ensured by her.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: And this is... Taliesin. He's a bard from Mondstadt... and goodness knows why he insisted on coming down here with us.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Also, perhaps you'll discover new allies once you get down into the mines, eh? Haha, who knows?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: And last but not least, you have me, the super hands-on surveyor! My job is to help scout the way forward and draw maps, which I'll share with you all, of course!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Well, please head over to the crane by the mines once you're ready. Originally, it was meant to transport goods, but it can also bring a few people up and down the mines, no problem!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Hmm, that said, since you have your wind glider, I suppose that you'd be fine even without the crane, eh?

choices.text: If you really wanted to stop me, you'd have chased me off some time ago now.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: If you understood what I said at all, please stop hanging around this place.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: If not...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If not...?

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: *sigh* If not nothing, really. All I can do is write weekly reports.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Weekly reports?

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Just a somewhat bothersome, meaningless, but nonetheless necessary document.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't you just stop writing them?

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: That won't do. I have to at least inform people that you've shown up here, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: The last report was sent out yesterday. In other words, the Ministry of Civil Affairs should get word of your presence here in a couple of days.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: When that happens, someone might actually drop by and forcibly get you to leave.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: So you're free to act before then, got it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got it.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: That's good. Hmph, if it wasn't for your great deeds in Liyue's service... Eh, you know what? Forget it.

talks.objective: Report the destruction of the Bedrock Keys to Zhiqiong

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back! The three Bedrock Keys have all been destroyed.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Shh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...What's up all of a sudden?

choices.text: What happened?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Don't start! It's nothing much... just the earth shaking, that's all. Perhaps the mountain rocks are being destabilized by the loosening of the seal... Do you feel it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Not at all...

choices.text: You fly, so of course you don't.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh. That's a good point...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I guess it's just a miner's instinct. If you grew up in a mine since you were young, you'd know a thing or two about the language of the stones.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Wait... Watch out!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! The ground really is shaking! Paimon's having trouble standing straight!

choices.text: You don't stand at all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aaaahhh! Eh... the shaking... stopped?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Phew... Looks like it's over for now. Thankfully, we were above ground. If we were in the mines when this earthquake happened...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Hopefully, Muning and the others don't blame this on us.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: But now, the sealing array's power has been greatly decreased. We just need to deal with that last Bedrock Key. Let's go!

choices.text: How does that even happen to you again?
I didn't either.
Are there enemies nearby?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Enemies? Where?

talks.objective: Look for the final Bedrock Key
Look for the final Bedrock Key
